en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on the Immaterial Sphere (Arūpāvacaraduka).

Dependent on a non-demonstrable, non-reactive, immaterial-sphere state, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not of the immaterial sphere, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six ... [as above] ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a non-demonstrable, non-reactive, non-immaterial-sphere state, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor with-reaction and is not of the immaterial sphere, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three ... [as above] ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
